title: review.json — agent-written review input
description: Version 1 manual/finder input, or version 2 coordinator aggregate with a required execution reference. What the agent writes: findings with code evidence, optional spec checks and receipts, and an optional summary. verdict derives approval from stored findings. The document is closed: an approved, body or comments[] key is not published, and a document without findings[] refuses. Errors: wrong schema_version, missing findings, finding path/line/severity/claim/quote/confidence shape or enum failures, malformed spec_checks or receipts, shape failures in the retained claim arrays, and any root key the schema does not publish. Warnings: an anchor outside the reviewed hunks (record moves the finding to the body), an unknown finding key, unset rigor, an unknown or non-string category, brief parts that fail validation, a malformed kb id, unattested chunks, and a malformed diagram block (diagram-invalid); --strict/strict_input promotes every warning to a refusal.

schema_version.description: Finder input uses version 1; execution-bound aggregate input uses version 2.

findings.description: Required array of findings. Each finding carries a path, strict integer line, severity, claim, quoted code, and finder confidence; the claim is stored as the finding body.

spec_checks.description: Optional spec items with status met, violated or n/a and one quoted evidence location. S4 enforces coverage and quote matching; S1 stores them.

receipts.description: Optional changed-hunk receipts: a hunk and a quote. S4 matches them against the pinned diff; S1 stores them.

summary.description: Optional root-only prose summary, at most 2000 characters. It is not a body: verdict renders the body.

resolved.description: Finding sigs (full or unambiguous prefix) the run addresses. Bare claims only record history; addressed needs verification.json evidence. A non-array or non-string item refuses.

triage.description: Status claims with rationale. Unknown status refuses the run; unknown sig warns; rationale under 30 chars keeps the prior status. Shape and enum failures refuse.

chunks.description: Coverage attestation on chunked bundles: every manifest chunk name the synthesis covers. Missing warns; non-array/non-string entries and attested-but-partial coverage refuse.

security_summary.description: One-paragraph security read; a non-string value refuses.

diagram.description: The optional behavioral diagram: nodes and edges that each quote a NEW-side diff line inside a hunk (added or context). verdict verifies every quote against full.diff, drops what the diff does not prove, and renders the mermaid block itself; raw mermaid is never an input. A diagram never withholds approval.

path.description: Diff-relative path required; a path not in the fetched diff refuses.

start_line.description: Optional strict integer multi-line range start; absent or null means the finding occupies one line.

suggestion.description: A fenced suggestion warns and demotes to the body (a fence inside would break rendering); a non-string value refuses.

brief.description: Optional machine brief. Shape, type, required-field, and range failures refuse; a site outside every hunk, past a cap, or a short approach/question warns and drops only that part.

kb.description: Cited knowledge-base rule ids; a non-array or non-string entry refuses, and a malformed id warns and drops.

side.description: RIGHT or LEFT; defaults to RIGHT.

severity.description: Required severity: critical, important or informational. The verdict-owned approval gate reads this field.

claim.description: Required one-sentence defect claim, stored as the finding body so existing signatures stay stable.

quote.description: Required code excerpt at path:line; S4 verifies it against the pinned diff.

confidence.description: Required finder confidence: high, medium or low. Stored as finder_confidence, separate from panel confidence.

rigor.description: Optional evidence rung: said, pointed, walked, ran or reproduced. Gates already published for rigor are unchanged in S1.

category.description: Optional closed taxonomy: logic|edge-case|security|performance|accidental-commit|style|docs|other. Unknown or non-string values warn once and store null; never inferred from prose, path, severity, or rule.

line.description: Required strict integer NEW-side line; a string, null, boolean or absent line refuses. An anchor outside the reviewed hunks warns and moves the finding to the body.

status.description: met, violated, unmet or n/a; violated and unmet withhold approval, and only those two fail the spec gate.

note.description: Optional one-line reason, at most 500 characters: required for unmet (what is missing) and expected for n/a (why it does not apply), forbidden content never echoed in a problem message.

evidence.description: One quoted code location: path, strict integer line, and quote. Required for met and violated; refused for unmet and n/a, which have no diff line to cite.

hunk.description: The pinned diff hunk header this receipt proves was read.

quote.description: The quoted line from that hunk; S4 matches it to the pinned diff.

brief.description: The machine form of the finding: affected sites, the required outcome, an optional approach, and open questions.

sites.description: Affected changed files with an optional reviewed line. Site shape/type/line failures refuse; a site outside every hunk or past the 10-site cap warns and drops.

outcome.description: One sentence naming what the fix must achieve — required, 10–500 characters; missing, non-string, or out-of-range refuses the review.

approach.description: Optional suggested approach, 10–1,000 characters; a non-string or out-of-range value refuses.

questions.description: Optional questions for the human, at most 10 of 10–300 characters each; non-array/non-string or an out-of-range or past-cap question refuses.

line.description: Reviewed line inside a hunk; absent means the whole file.

diagram.description: One behavioral diagram: a supported type, an optional title, and the nodes and edges with their quoted diff lines. A verified quote proves the cited line exists; the relation an edge draws stays the agent's claim. A shape defect is a `diagram-invalid` warning, never a refusal: an out-of-scope type omits the block, a malformed element counts as supplied and is dropped, and a value past its cap is truncated when drawn.

type.description: The diagram vocabulary: `sequence` draws steps over time, `state` a lifecycle, `flow` a control graph. Any other string is accepted and out of scope: a diagram-invalid warning, and the block is omitted with a one-line note.

title.description: Optional short title; it renders as the accessible title. Past 120 characters it is a diagram-invalid warning and is truncated.

nodes.description: The nodes the diagram draws; at most 24 render. An empty list is accepted with a diagram-invalid warning and omits the block with a note. A node whose quote does not verify is dropped, and the quote matcher stops after 240 nodes.

edges.description: The transitions between nodes; at most 40 render. An edge whose own quote fails, or whose endpoint was dropped or names no node, is never drawn, and the quote matcher stops after 400 edges.

diagramNode.description: One node anchored to the diff line it stands for.

id.description: The lookup key edges name, up to 40 characters. It is never rendered: the block draws generated identifiers. An empty or repeated id drops the node with a diagram-invalid warning.

label.description: The text the node shows. Only letters, digits, combining marks, spaces, and the punctuation .,:!?'()+_-/@ survive; past 120 characters it is truncated to end in three dots, and an empty label shows the generated id.

evidence.description: The diff line the node stands for, in the spec_checks evidence shape: a NEW-side path, line, and the exact quote of a line inside a hunk (added or context).

diagramEdge.description: One transition anchored to its own diff line.

from.description: The `id` of the node the transition starts at.

to.description: The `id` of the node the transition ends at.

label.description: Optional transition text, sanitized and truncated like a node label. An unlabeled sequence message carries its target node's label, so the message text is never empty.

evidence.description: The diff line the transition cites, in the spec_checks evidence shape: a NEW-side path, line, and the exact quote of a line inside a hunk (added or context). Verification proves the line exists, not that it states the relation.
